Slide 6. Both AI4R and containerized CCs may invoke shared inference through a stable lab-scoped model interface. At launch inject the reachable base URL or client configuration, scoped credential reference, and authorized model aliases; container localhost is not the guest host. Authors declare roles and required features such as tool calling, structured output, modality and context capacity, with an optional exact model/version constraint. The lab operator or authorized configuration fills the available-model registry and route mappings. Availability alone is not compatibility. Resolve the binding before invocation, record the selected model/version/route and inference settings, and preserve it for the attempt. Endpoint relocation can preserve a model binding; replacing the model requires explicit compatible policy/new binding, and exact-model experiments cannot silently switch. Missing compatible routes wait or fail visibly.
This is a logical responsibility, not a requirement for another custom daemon. Prefer existing model adapters and injected configuration initially; evaluate a gateway if centralized credential/routing policy justifies it. JiuwenBox documents inference request routing and API-key injection; LiteLLM documents public model names mapped to provider deployments. Neither establishes our full contract. The proxy uses path-prefix route targets and injected credentials; this is not evidence of model-feature discovery, alias-to-model matching or experiment pinning. Sandbox stop calls runtime.stop then persists STOPPED. Runtime.stop stops owned background processes, requests daemon shutdown, waits, then escalates through process-group SIGTERM/SIGKILL if necessary and waits again. This is implemented termination logic, not a runtime pass or proof that arbitrary Docker CC workloads are covered. A background kill may report permission_denied; callers must inspect outcomes. Resource limits are optional and require effective host support. Sandbox lifecycle/audit persistence is distinct from research continuity, consistent application checkpoints and independent backup.
